title: Fake instant-loan app: fourth 'processing fee'
story: An instant-loan app approved ₹2 lakh but asked for a ₹999 'file charge', then ₹1,500 'GST' and ₹2,500 'insurance'. Now it wants ₹4,000 'NOC fee' before disbursal.
why: A rising series of fees to new accounts, and the payee is already reported on the cybercrime portal. An outside flag plus the series should be enough to stop it.
